definitions.description: 业务时区 Asia/Shanghai，期间为半开区间 [start,end)。合格订单已支付、未取消且非测试账号。区域采用下单区域 orders.region_id。按支付时间统计商品金额减优惠，不含运费、不扣退款。品类按商品行 quantity*unit_price-COALESCE(item_discount,0) 汇总，避免订单连接放大；空输入返回 NULL。
definitions.expression_template:
SELECT {{ bucket }} AS grain,
       {% if grain == 'category' %}SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price - COALESCE(i.item_discount, 0)){% else %}SUM(o.gross_amount - COALESCE(o.discount_amount, 0)){% endif %} AS gmv
FROM biz.orders o JOIN biz.customers c USING (customer_id)
{% if grain == 'category' %}JOIN biz.order_items i USING (order_id)
JOIN biz.products p USING (product_id)
{% endif %}WHERE {{ date_field }} >= TIMESTAMPTZ '{{ period_start }}'
  AND {{ date_field }} < TIMESTAMPTZ '{{ period_end }}'
  AND o.paid_at IS NOT NULL
  AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
  AND c.is_test_account = false
{% if grain != 'total' %}GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1{% endif %};

definitions.description: 业务时区 Asia/Shanghai，期间为半开区间 [start,end)。合格订单已支付、未取消且非测试账号。区域采用下单区域 orders.region_id。分子按 requested_at 统计期间非 rejected 的退款申请去重订单数，分母按 paid_at 统计同期合格支付订单数。两侧独立聚合避免多笔退款放大；零分母返回 NULL。这是流量比值，可超过 100%，不是支付同期群概率。退款状态知识截至种子观察截止 2026-12-15T00:00:00+08:00；后续退款月份没有同期订单分母时不报告为 0。
definitions.expression_template:
WITH numerator AS (
  SELECT {{ bucket }} AS grain, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)::numeric AS refunded_orders
  FROM biz.refunds r JOIN biz.orders o USING (order_id)
  JOIN biz.customers c USING (customer_id)
  WHERE r.requested_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '{{ period_start }}'
    AND r.requested_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '{{ period_end }}'
    AND r.status <> 'rejected'
    AND o.paid_at IS NOT NULL AND o.status <> 'cancelled' AND c.is_test_account = false
  {% if grain != 'total' %}GROUP BY 1{% endif %}
), denominator AS (
  SELECT {{ paid_bucket }} AS grain, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS paid_orders
  FROM biz.orders o JOIN biz.customers c USING (customer_id)
  WHERE o.paid_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '{{ period_start }}'
    AND o.paid_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '{{ period_end }}'
    AND o.paid_at IS NOT NULL AND o.status <> 'cancelled' AND c.is_test_account = false
  {% if grain != 'total' %}GROUP BY 1{% endif %}
)
SELECT COALESCE(n.grain, d.grain) AS grain,
       COALESCE(n.refunded_orders, 0) / NULLIF(d.paid_orders, 0) AS refund_rate
FROM numerator n FULL OUTER JOIN denominator d USING (grain)
ORDER BY 1;
